answers.Q1: The November 7, 2026 overview at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/stablecoin-payments describes customer-authenticated direct stablecoin payments. Stripe redirects a buyer selecting Crypto to crypto.stripe.com to choose a currency and network and connect a wallet. The buyer gets a completion notification and may return to the merchant. Completed payments settle in the merchant's local-currency Stripe balance, while USD presentment is listed and other currencies are in private preview (new raw lines 9-29, 109-123 and 141-147). Global customers exclude sanctioned countries. Supported merchants are separately identified through US availability and named private previews. Connect requires each account to have the method enabled and gives distinct Dashboard/request routes (new raw lines 55-100 and 161-173). The May overview specified US-only merchants and USD balance settlement (old raw lines 8-20, 54-60 and 103-109); source-stripe-stablecoin-payments.md retains that older text as undated guidance and omits the November Tempo and US-only token qualifiers. The overview describes completion rather than a PaymentIntent state sequence. Separately versioned API evidence distinguishes blockchain submission and processing from finalization and optional merchant return.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/stablecoin-payments, the substantive November changes are the merchant-preview breakout, USD presentment with other currencies in private preview, local-currency Stripe-balance settlement, and dated direct checkout token/network wording (new raw lines 9-25, 61-100 and 141-147). Preserve the May 1, 2026 US-only and USD-only settlement evidence and the older token/network table (old raw lines 8-20, 54-60 and 103-109). In source-stripe-stablecoin-payments.md distinguish the named private preview regions from the detailed list, including GI, LI and NO, and do not merge checkout USDC on Tempo with stablecoin balances or USDC.e transfers, Link's separately scoped USD payments, or API reporting enums. The icons, heading and getting-started link changes are presentational or navigational; the core wallet flow, 10,000 USD cap, original-wallet refunds and Connect active qualification are retained (old raw lines 69-99 and 105-135; new raw lines 109-173). Preserve root index line 7, Stripe index lines 238 and 760 and the Stablecoin Payments concept's source and distinct Link routes at lines 38-40 and 52-54. Add the source backlink and retain both factual captures.
